verdict.rationale: QuickBooks exposes OAuth 2.0 authentication (via intuit oauth-jsclient) and has an MCP server with 145 tools covering the full QBO API, but there is no evidence of a mechanism to issue scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent (e.g., restricting which of the 145 tools/endpoints an agent's token can access). Missing for 10: documentation of OAuth scope granularity for agent use cases, any agent-specific API key/token issuance flow, or role-based restriction of MCP tool access.
